subject: Intro demo & multi‑stakeholder scheduling for Novalabs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Bates <oliver.bates@novalabs.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo & logistics for Novalabs (self-serve signup)

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for signing up and for the quick call yesterday. You mentioned wanting a short technical + product walkthrough with your platform team and IT/security on the initial call. I want to get all stakeholders aligned before we lock a slot. Can you confirm who from your side should join (AE/SE/IT/security)?

Proposed windows next week (my local / your local):
- Tue Jul 6, 09:00–10:00 PDT / 18:00–19:00 CEST
- Wed Jul 7, 11:00–12:00 PDT / 20:00–21:00 CEST
- Thu Jul 8, 08:00–09:00 PDT / 17:00–18:00 CEST

If IT/security will join, they sometimes ask for a short checklist in advance (network/IPs, data flow, retention, SOC2 scope). If you want, I can loop in our SE and attach the checklist ahead of time so your team can review.

Notes: demo will be ~45 minutes (20m infra, 20m product demo, 5–10m Q&A).

Quick ask: please reply with the names/titles for the meeting invite and which of the above windows work best.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
From: Oliver Bates <oliver.bates@novalabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Zielinska <m.zielinska@eurocore.io>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo & logistics for Novalabs (self-serve signup)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks. Please include our Platform lead and security lead:
- Tomas Novak (Platform)
- Marta Zielinska (Security, EuroCore consultancy)

Marta asked me to flag that she needs a short security questionnaire before the call (we try to avoid deep dives on the first meeting). I attached a short set of items we typically want covered (networking, SSO, data residency, audit logs). Would you be able to share Redwood's checklist?

For availability, Thu Jul 8, 17:00–18:00 CEST looks best for Tomas + Marta. If that slot doesn't work for you, Wed Jul 7, 20:00 CEST is our backup.

Appreciate it —
Oliver
Senior Cloud Ops, Novalabs
oliver.bates@novalabs.com

-----
Attachment: novalabs-security-questions.pdf (doc, 6 pages)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Bates <oliver.bates@novalabs.com>, Tomas Novak <tomas.novak@novalabs.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo & logistics for Novalabs (confirming Thu Jul 8)

Hi Oliver / Tomas / Marta —

Thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the items. Thu Jul 8 at 17:00 CEST works for our team (that is Thu Jul 8, 08:00 PDT). I'll block a 45-minute slot and include a short pre-demo brief so Marta can scan the security/design talking points.

Proposed agenda (45m):
- 5m quick intros and goals
- 15m infra/architecture run-through (SE)
- 20m product demo + integration patterns
- 5m next steps + follow-ups (PoC, metrics to track)

Meeting details (provisional):
- Thu Jul 8, 17:00–17:45 CEST / 08:00–08:45 PDT
- Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/redwood-demo-novalabs (calendar invite to follow)

Attachments: redwood-pre-demo-brief.pdf (short one‑pager for IT/security)

If Marta needs a deeper packet, Karthik (SE) will send the security checklist and IP ranges prior to the call. Karthik — can you confirm you'll join at 17:00 CEST and whether we need an IP whitelist?

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Zielinska <m.zielinska@eurocore.io>, Oliver Bates <oliver.bates@novalabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 12:02:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo & logistics for Novalabs (SE attendance + checklist)

Hi Marta / Oliver —

I'll be on the call at Thu Jul 8, 17:00 CEST. Short notes ahead of the meeting:
- Agenda split looks good: I'll take the infra/architecture portion and be prepared for the specific data residency and audit-log questions.
- Pre-call ask: if you could share any specific IP ranges or blocked ports we should be aware of, that helps. Otherwise we can run entirely over Meet.
- Attached: redwood-it-security-checklist.pdf (summary: SOC2 scoping, data segregation, retention, SSO flows, outgoing IP ranges).

On the PoC question: if Novalabs wants a sandbox connector we'll request a limited token and a temporary service account; we normally do a 2‑week sandbox with monitoring enabled. We'll cover next steps at the end of the demo.

See you Thu —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
